## What this course is {#sec-what-this-is}

An introduction to quantitative methods for international relations and European politics, taught with free and open source state of the art tools: R, Quarto, Git and GitHub, all inside Positron.
You will learn regression as a way of describing relationships in data, and Bayesian inference as a way of saying how certain you are about them.

The whole term runs toward one skill, an eight-step analysis taking you from a research question to an empirical answer with its uncertainty attached.
You see that route in session 1, deepen one part of it each week, and run it end to end yourself in the take-home exam.
No programming experience and no statistics beyond descriptives are assumed.
